source_read: https://tkmenus.com/socialpubkitchen (8 published menu pages + 2 Scottish twins, downloaded afresh 2026-10-08)
notes: All 221 items.csv rows matched an independently regex-parsed dish box on kcal, kJ, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, salt and on Contains / may-contain / cereals / tree nuts; every source row with a calorie figure is published or explained (the 3 Scotland-only no-gluten breakfasts are skipped by design); rerunning the script on the fresh pages reproduces data/source byte for byte. Oasis cans print a carbs figure but no protein or fat, so are calories-only (carbs left out, noted).
